PF mein ₹5,000 extra daalein to retirement par kitna banega? 🤔

✅ ₹5,000 mahina x 30 saal = ₹74.3 lakh (aapka jama sirf ₹18 lakh)
✅ ₹2,000 mahina = ₹29.7 lakh, ₹10,000 mahina = ₹1.49 crore
✅ Basic ₹40,000 wale Rahul ka corpus: ₹2.21 Cr se ₹2.95 Cr
✅ Apna EPF + VPF ₹2.5 lakh/saal se upar gaya to extra interest par tax

(8.25% rate maan kar. Rate badal sakta hai. Educational only.)
